senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; נָעַל , v. נַעַל) foot-covering, shoe, contrad. to סנדל sole.
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 8:7">Esth. R. to IV, 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00354"><he>לָחַךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 12:10">Tosef. ib. XII, 10</cite> <he>במ׳ שנפרם וכ׳</he> with a torn shoe which still covers the larger portion of the foot; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִנְעָלִים</he>, <he>מִנְעָלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:3">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
Kil. IX, 7 מִנְעֲלוֹת הפינון. cloth socks, v. דַּרְדְּסָא.
